name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: You can now make your own bandage pouch. To try it, you need to camp in the wilderness, where a campfire is also needed.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: The pouch is ready to make, but most people dislike camps in the middle of town. You need to try it in the wilderness. A campfire is required before you can set up camp, and most cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Where can I try the bandage pouch?
faq.answer: You need to try it in the wilderness, since most people dislike camps in the middle of town.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you can set up camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you how to make a campfire.
